record.question: The 16 year old climate activist from Sweden who was conferred with Amnesty International Ambassador of Conscience Award 2019 is:
record.explanation: Answer A: Greta Thunberg. Greta Thunberg received Amnesty International’s 2019 Ambassador of Conscience Award. Reference: https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2019/06/greta-thunberg-and-fridays-for-future-receive-amnesty-international-ambassador-of-conscience-award/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
